data.one_liner: Create complex, resizable, multi-pane layouts for IDE-like and desktop interfaces.
data.what_it_does: Provides resizable horizontal and vertical multi-pane layouts, pre-built IDE-like structures with sidebars and bottom panels, and tabbed interfaces. Allows programmatic control, dynamic pane management, state serialization, and custom theming.
use_when: Building a desktop-style application or complex dashboard with resizable panels
Creating an IDE-like interface with customizable sidebars and bottom terminals
Needing to save and restore complex user-adjusted layout states
avoid_when: Building simple mobile applications with standard navigation and scrolling lists
Needing standard Material or Cupertino layout scaffolds without split views
strengths: Flexible layout configurations with nested horizontal and vertical panes
Supports dynamic runtime pane management, serialization, and keyboard accessibility
Pre-configured IDE layout with multiple bottom panel positioning modes
weaknesses: Limited primarily to multi-pane and split-view design patterns
Relies entirely on package-specific controllers for programmatic mutations
